_comment: Player-facing change notes for every listed patch of the masteries page (index.html), shown by the patch-notes control next to the Patch dropdown. Hand-curated from data/patches/masteries.json (changes, notes, sources) and the research behind it: every bullet is backed by that data, nothing is added.

patches: { <patch as in the listing>: { summary, items, kind } }. summary: one line, at most 90 characters, ending in " (approx.)" when the listing's confidence is low. items: short bullets, old → new values, at most about 8. kind: launch | rework | change | season-start | season-end | no-change; a season boundary without a mastery change is no-change, and its count in the registry is 0.
tools/build-notes.js checks this file against the listing and writes data/notes/masteries-<season>.js (one LolData.register("notes", ...) per season).

V1.0.0.32.summary: Launch: the 30-point Offense / Defense / Utility trees
items: Release build of the classic Offense / Defense / Utility trees, as of the last beta patch V0.9.25.34
Launch values that change later in Season 1: Mender's Faith +75 Heal and 10s shorter Heal cooldown; Willpower 30s shorter Cleanse cooldown; Cripple: Exhaust also removes 25 Armor and Magic Resist
Demolisher (Promote upgrade) is still in the Offense tree; Improved Rally +20% base magic damage; Reinforce +9 damage to minions and monsters while Fortify is up
Haste +8% Ghost Movement Speed; Ardor half at level 1, full at 18; Havoc +5% base damage
Strength of Spirit 0.5/1/1.5% of max mana as health regen; Meditation 1.66/3.33/5 mana regen per 5s; Veteran's Scars +15/30/45/60 health

Demolisher removed together with the Promote summoner spell; Offense tier 4 keeps only Brute Force

Meditation: 1.66/3.33/5 → 1/2/3 mana regen per 5s
Veteran's Scars: +15/30/45/60 → +12/24/36/48 health

15 prerequisite links, for example Butcher → Feast, Brute Force → Martial Mastery, Block → Unyielding

More launch values: Bandit +15 gold on melee takedowns, Meditation 1/2/3 mana regen, Expanded Mind 2/3.5/5% mana, Inspiration 5/10 experience, Intelligence 4/7/10% item cooldowns, Wanderer 5% Movement Speed

V5.10.summary: Utility overhaul: Expanded Mind and Meditation swap places, 6 masteries changed
items: Expanded Mind moves to tier 1 and Meditation to tier 4; Strength of Spirit now requires Expanded Mind
Expanded Mind: 2/3.5/5% max mana → flat 25/50/75 mana
Meditation: 1/2/3 mana regen per 5s → 0.5/1/1.5% missing mana every 5s
Bandit: melee +15 gold on takedown → +8 gold per champion hit (ranged 3), 5s per target
Inspiration: 5/10 → 10/20 experience every 10s
Intelligence: item cooldowns 4/7/10% → 8/14/20% (Cooldown Reduction 2/3.5/5% unchanged)
Wanderer: 5% → flat 20 out-of-combat Movement Speed

V5.12.summary: Defense overhaul: 5 masteries move tiers; Adaptive Armor replaces Runic Blessing
items: Swiftness: tier 4 → tier 1, 1 → 2 ranks, slow reduction 10% → 7.5/15%
Enchanted Armor: tier 1 → tier 5, 2 → 4 ranks, 2.5/5% → 2.5/5/7.5/10% bonus Armor and Magic Resist
Tenacious: tier 6 → tier 3, crowd control reduction 15% → 10%
Oppression: tier 3 → tier 5, damage reduction 3% → 2%
Legendary Guardian: tier 5 → tier 6, 4 ranks → 1, now +3 Armor and +3 Magic Resist per nearby enemy champion
Runic Blessing removed; new Adaptive Armor (tier 4): 4% of your higher bonus resist granted as the other

V5.21.summary: No mastery changes since V5.12; last patch of Season 5
items: No mastery changes since V5.12 — last patch of Season 5

V5.22.summary: Preseason 6: Ferocity / Cunning / Resolve trees with keystones
items: The 2014 trees are replaced by Ferocity, Cunning and Resolve: 13 masteries per tree, 39 in total
6 tiers per tree: tiers 1, 3 and 5 share 5 points between two masteries, tiers 2 and 4 are a choice of two, tier 6 a choice of three keystones; up to 18 points per tree, one keystone
Ferocity keystones: Warlord's Bloodlust (crits heal 15%, +20% Attack Speed), Fervor of Battle (10 stacks of 1–8 on-hit damage), Deathfire Touch (6 + 50% bonus AD + 20% AP over 3s)

Cunning keystones: Stormraider's Surge (30% max health in 2s grants 35% Movement Speed), Thunderlord's Decree (10 per level + 20% bonus AD + 10% AP, 30s cooldown), Windspeaker's Blessing (+10% heals and shields, +15% resists)
Resolve keystones: Grasp of the Undying (3% max health), Strength of the Ages, Bond of Stone (4% damage reduction, doubled near an ally, 8% redirected)

V5.23.summary: Thunderlord's Decree cooldown 30s → 20s; Bond of Stone 4% → 2%
items: Thunderlord's Decree: cooldown 30s → 20s
Bond of Stone: base damage reduction 4% → 2% (8% near an ally; redirect 8%)
Tooltip fix: Perseverance's health threshold reads 25% (was 20%; the real threshold was always 25%)
Tooltip wording: about 25 masteries rewritten with the same numbers

V5.24.summary: New Assassin mastery; Thunderlord's, Deathfire, Fervor, Windspeaker's and 6 more
items: New mastery: Assassin (Cunning tier 2, third option): 1.5% more damage while no allied champions are nearby
Thunderlord's Decree: bonus AD ratio 20% → 30%; Deathfire Touch: 6 → 8 + 50% bonus AD + 20% AP, over 3s → 4s
Fervor of Battle: stacks only from champions, melee attacks and ability hits give 2 stacks (2s cooldown on ability stacks), stacks last 5s → 6s
Windspeaker's Blessing: +15% resists → +5–22 Armor (by level) and half as much Magic Resist
Bond of Stone: 3% damage reduction (6% near an ally), redirect 6%, redirect stops below 5% health (was 15%)
Precision: armor penetration 0.6–3 → 1–5 (+0.06–0.3 → +0.1–0.5 per level)
Unyielding: 1.2–6% → 1–5% bonus Armor and Magic Resist; Explorer: 12 → 15 Movement Speed in brush and river
Veteran's Scars: 0.8–4% max health → +9/18/27/36/45 health; Feast: cooldown 20s → 25s

V6.1.summary: Keystone retune: Bloodlust, Stormraider's, Fervor, Deathfire, Strength of the Ages
items: Warlord's Bloodlust: crit heal 15% → 5–25% by level; Attack Speed 20% → 30%
Stormraider's Surge: window 2s → 2.5s, Movement Speed 35% → 40%, new 75% slow resistance
Fervor of Battle: 1–8 → 1–14 damage per stack, max stacks 10 → 8
Deathfire Touch: ratios 50% bonus AD / 20% AP → 60% / 25%
Strength of the Ages: at the 300 bonus health cap, siege minion kills heal 6% max health (was 100 health), now also large monster kills
Bond of Stone: 4% damage reduction; the near-ally increase is removed, redirect stays 6%
Precision: armor penetration back to 0.6–3 (+0.06–0.3 per level)
Bug fix: Battering Blows / Piercing Thoughts gave the wrong stats when points were split between them
Assassin: 1.5% → 2%, now only against champions
Thunderlord's Decree: cooldown 20s → 25–15s by level; mark window 5s → 3s
Windspeaker's Blessing: the patch notes clarify there is no resist bonus on yourself (tooltip unchanged)

V6.4.summary: New Expose Weakness mastery; Warlord's Bloodlust reworked into life steal
items: New mastery: Expose Weakness (Ferocity tier 2, third option): damaged enemy champions take 3% more damage from your allies
Warlord's Bloodlust reworked: life steal that grows with missing health, up to 20% against champions (half against minions); crit heal and Attack Speed removed
Tooltip wording: Bond of Stone (the 5% health redirect limit is back in the text), Thunderlord's Decree, Deathfire Touch, Precision

V6.7.summary: Warlord's Bloodlust: ranged life steal vs minions 50% → 25%

V6.22.summary: Preseason 7: 45 masteries, 3 choices per row; Courage of the Colossus
items: Preseason 7: 45 masteries (15 per tree); every tier 2 and tier 4 row now offers 3 choices
Ferocity: Fresh Blood added (first attack on a champion deals 10 + 1 per level bonus damage, 6s cooldown); Double Edged Sword moves to tier 4, 3% / 1.5% → 5% / 2.5%
Ferocity tier 4: Oppressor removed, Battle Trance added (up to 5% more damage over 5s in champion combat); Bounty Hunter 1% → 1.5% per unique kill
Fervor of Battle: 1–6 bonus AD per stack (by level), 10 stacks, 4s, basic attacks only
Cunning: Greenfather's Gift added (after entering brush, next damaging attack or ability deals 3% current health magic damage, 9s cooldown); Precision: armor penetration → 1.7–8.5 Lethality
Resolve: Siegemaster added (+8 Armor and Magic Resist near an allied tower) and Fearless added (+10% + 2 per level bonus resists for 2s when hit by a champion, 9s cooldown)
Resolve keystone: Strength of the Ages replaced by Courage of the Colossus (shield 10 + 10 per level + 7% max health per nearby enemy champion after hard crowd control, 30s cooldown)

V6.24.summary: Fervor of Battle 1–8 AD per stack; Courage of the Colossus 7% → 5%

Courage of the Colossus: 7% → 5% max health per nearby enemy; cooldown 30s → 45–30s by level

V7.2.summary: Courage of the Colossus: shield 3–54 per nearby enemy, 3s

Bounty Hunter: 1.5% → 1% per unique kill (max 5%)
Double Edged Sword: 5% / 2.5% → 3% / 1.5%

V7.5.summary: Bond of Stone becomes Stoneborn Pact; Warlord's Bloodlust reworked again
items: Bond of Stone reworked as Stoneborn Pact: +5% max health; movement-impairing crowd control marks enemy champions for 4s, allies hitting them heal 5 + 2.5% of your max health over 2s (half if you are ranged)
Warlord's Bloodlust reworked: moving and attacking charge an Energized attack with 1–50% life steal (by level) and 30% Movement Speed for 0.75s
Deathfire Touch: bonus AD ratio 60% → 45%

V7.6.summary: Warlord's Bloodlust: Energized heal 5–40% of total AD
items: Warlord's Bloodlust: Energized heal 1–50% life steal → heal for 5–40% of total AD (by level), increased by critical strikes

V7.21.summary: No mastery changes since V7.6; the last patch with masteries
items: No mastery changes since V7.6 — last patch with masteries; V7.22 replaces them with Runes Reforged
